items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: like the late and great Thomas "Fats" Waller

ctx.x: I see. Well now, when Fletcher came back from college and you say you requested him to play things, was this still classical music or by this time was he playing --

No. He went to Atlanta University and somewhere along the way he picked that beat up. He always had it of course, but -- the popular music, you know -- we got so we'd buy the sheet music, and Fletcher would know all the tunes, and of course, he had a little band going to school in Atlanta University, and he used to play there, and of course, when he would come home, why, we would look forward to hearing some of these things that the band played, and he would sit down and play them and tell us about them and…
